advisories.title: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
advisories.reason: All three advisories are parse-time. office-text-extractor only calls js-yaml's dump() to format spreadsheet rows. Electron's app-builder-lib parses our own build config at build time. The sandbox-yaml pack bundles its own copy into the QuickJS guest, where the run's CPU timeout bounds a quadratic parse.

advisories.title: ip SSRF improper categorization in isPublic
advisories.reason: Optional dependency of werift via node-av, used for ICE candidates. NodeTool's SSRF checks (safeFetch) do not use ip.isPublic.

advisories.title: undici vulnerable to cross-user information disclosure and parse-time crash via degenerate private cache directives
advisories.reason: Affects the hoisted undici 7.28 that cheerio uses for fromURL. NodeTool loads HTML with cheerio.load and never calls fromURL. The cache interceptor, WebSocket client and BalancedPool are not used. The API server's own undici (packages/websocket) is 7.30, which is fixed.

advisories.title: simple-git: unsafe-operations plugin bypass via git long-option abbreviation (--receive-p/--exe) -> command execution (residual of CVE-2026-28291)
advisories.reason: Reached only through node-llama-cpp, which uses simple-git to clone llama.cpp source in its own CLI. NodeTool never calls that path or passes git options. Fix needs node-llama-cpp 4 (major).

advisories.title: expr-eval vulnerable to Prototype Pollution
advisories.reason: Formula strings come from sandbox guests. __proto__ assignments and constructor access did not pollute Object.prototype when tried against 2.0.2. No patched release. Follow-up: replace with expr-eval-fork@3.

advisories.title: simple-git allows command execution through unblocked Git configuration includes
advisories.reason: Reached only through node-llama-cpp, which uses simple-git to clone llama.cpp source in its own CLI. NodeTool never calls that path or passes git options. Fix needs node-llama-cpp 4 (major).

advisories.title: Tiptap: Quadratic ReDoS in block and inline Markdown attribute parsing
advisories.reason: Pulled in by @puckeditor/core for the app builder's rich-text fields. ReDoS in Markdown attribute parsing affects the editing user's own tab. The fix needs the whole @tiptap family moved together (core 3.31 pins @tiptap/pm 3.31), which Puck must allow.

advisories.title: expr-eval does not restrict functions passed to the evaluate function
advisories.reason: Needs attacker-controlled functions in the evaluate() context. The sandbox-expr host module receives its variables from the QuickJS guest as JSON data, so no function can arrive. Follow-up: replace with expr-eval-fork@3.

advisories.title: MapLibre GL JS: XSS Sanitizer Bypass in DOM.sanitize() via Live NamedNodeMap Removal Skip
advisories.reason: Reached through plotly.js map traces in the web app. Reachability of MapLibre's DOM.sanitize from Plotly figure data is not traced. Fix needs plotly.js 4 (major). Follow-up: trace or upgrade.

advisories.title: @grpc/grpc-js: In certain configurations, getAuthContext can return unauthorized certificates as though they were authorized
advisories.reason: Only the OpenTelemetry OTLP gRPC log exporter uses it, as a client. The advisory concerns getAuthContext on a server, which NodeTool does not run. npm keeps 1.14.4 hoisted although ^1.14.3 allows 1.14.5.

advisories.title: expr-eval vulnerable to Code Execution
advisories.reason: Needs toJSFunction(). The only caller, packages/agents/src/host-modules/expr.ts, calls Parser.evaluate(). No patched release. Follow-up: replace with expr-eval-fork@3.

advisories.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
advisories.reason: Via chokidar 3 in tailwindcss at build time. Glob patterns come from our own config, not users.

advisories.title: LinkifyIt#match scan loop has quadratic algorithmic complexity
advisories.reason: markdown-it link detection in chat rendering. Quadratic scans on hostile text slow only the device rendering that message. No fixed release yet.

advisories.title: Cross-site Scripting in Prism
advisories.reason: Syntax highlighting in chat through react-native-syntax-highlighter. Output renders as React Native Text, with no DOM, so the XSS advisories do not apply. The ReDoS affects only the user's own device. No fix in the Prism 1 line that the highlighter accepts.

advisories.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
advisories.reason: Used by Metro, the bundler, on our own assets at build time. Not shipped in the app. Fix needs a Metro release that moves past image-size ^1.

advisories.title: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
advisories.reason: Used by the Expo CLI for code-signing certificates at build time. Not shipped in the app. Fix needs an Expo SDK upgrade.
